chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Ḥasanī, from Mūsā ibn Muḥammad, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from one whom he mentioned, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, concerning His, the Exalted's, saying:
And that if they had remained steadfast upon the path, We would surely have given them abundant water to drink.

He عليه السلام said: It means, if they had remained steadfast upon the wilayah of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, Amīr al-Muʾminīn, and the awṣiyāʾ from among his descendants عليهم السلام, and accepted obedience to them in their commands and their prohibitions, We would surely have given them abundant water to drink—meaning: We would have made their hearts drink faith. And the path is faith in the wilayah of ʿAlī and the awṣiyāʾ.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الطَّرِيقَةِ: the path, interpreted here as the way of true faith and steadfastness
key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: the successors appointed after Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْإِيمَانَ: faith placed firmly into the hearts
key_terms.طَاعَتَهُمْ: obedience to their commands and prohibitions
key_terms.مَاءً غَدَقًا: abundant water, interpreted here as an abundance of faith

ai.seo_question: What does Qur'an 72:16 mean in Shia tafsir regarding the path and abundant water?
ai.summary: This narration explains the verse as referring to steadfastness upon the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and the awṣiyāʾ from his descendants عليهم السلام. The promise of abundant water is interpreted as Allah filling their hearts with iman, making the 'path' a reference to belief in their divinely ordained authority.
